question: What hundred-thousandfold act at the forehead letter-mass is enjoined for the god-worshipped practitioner?
premises: This act is situated in the forehead letter-mass.
The instruction is addressed to a god-worshipped practitioner.
inference: The god-worshipped practitioner must perform a hundred-thousandfold act at the forehead letter-mass.
uncertainties: The precise nature of the act counted as lakṣaṃ is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: O one worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand at the mass of letters situated in the forehead.
